anatomy.vs_defaults: Our home is hero, collection, product-grid, journal, newsletter. Real sites put a product row second (right after the hero) and use categories (image tiles) on 7/8 — add 'categories' after product-grid and 'trust' near the top. Add a shop-the-look block (lookbook) on home. The 'collections' page should be grid-first (collection header + product-grid with filters), lookbook optional. Add 'product' (product page) as a recommended page type — every site has one and it is the conversion page. Promote 'shop' to recommended. Add 'bespoke/made-to-order' and 'stockists/boutique' as optional pages. Contact page: contact-cta + location; FAQ belongs on its own 'Help' page (shipping, returns, care) rather than contact. Team on About is rare — drop it from defaults; craftsmanship/process is what they show instead.
